messages:
sanjay: quick async sync on the postmortem follow-ups from this morning's rollout glitch. we keep seeing config-drift + unguarded flag scopes causing a spike in errors. want concrete owners + short timelines for auto-rollback, sampling limits, and a canary observability tile.
kevin: +1. propose two parallel streams: infra (auto-rollback, circuit-breaker windows, telemetry) and product/process (default flag scopes, pre-rollout checks).
maria: can we include a weekly audit for all active flags > 0.1%? that'd catch accidental wide scopes.
nina: yes. measurable proposals: auto-rollback trigger if 2m error_rate > 3% or latency p99 up 200ms; default max flag scope 2% global, 8% region-limited.
sanjay: good. action items I want on the board now:
- KEVIN = infra spec for auto-rollback + circuit-breaker (include backoff, safety window, alerting). due Mon EOD.
- NINA = default scope matrix + weekly flag audit plan. due Wed 11:59am.
- MARIA = add "rollback_guardrail_present" column and backfill last 18 incidents; also create a small taxonomy of causes. due Fri.
- OPS = add canary heatmap tile (last-10m error bursts by region/model) + alert if sudden >2x baseline. due Thu.
kevin: for rollback mechanism, leaning toward immediate flag-kill over model switch for fastest mitigation. will include both options in spec and run a latency test for flag kill path.
ops-bot: Reminder: infra ticket created -> TICK-3520. Use `/claim` to take ownership.
maria: I'll coordinate with product to ensure audits don't block urgent rollouts. propose a lightweight auto-snapshot for flags pre-rollout.
nina: process add: pre-rollout smoke run (10m), canary traffic ramp steps (1%, 2%, 5% with 10-20m holds), and a checklist checkbox in PR template.
sanjay: also add a small incident taxonomy field in our postmortem tracker: config-drift / rollout-scale / model-regression / infra-threshold. helps triage recurring patterns.
kevin: sample pseudocode for the infra spec I'll flesh out:```
window = 2m
if error_rate(window) > 0.03 or p99_latency(window) > baseline_p99 + 200ms:
  if canary_scope > 0.02:
    reduce_canary_scope_by(0.5) # shrink blast radius
  else:
    trigger_flag_kill(flag_id)
  notify(#incidents)
  open_timeline(TICK-3520)
```
maria: suggestion: add a "soft-kill" step that reduces sampling before full kill to give SREs a chance to confirm. default soft-kill = 50% reduction, repeat once.
nina: +1, soft-kill first, full-kill if metrics don't recover in 3 mins. add escalation to oncall.
sanjay: decisions captured: soft-kill -> full-kill fallback, default scope caps, canary heatmap tile, taxonomy column, weekly flag audit. owners and due dates assigned.
kevin: I'll open a PR with the infra spec and include a tiny sequence diagram + test plan. linking to TICK-3520. ETA Mon.
ops-bot: TICK-3520 updated: assignees kevin,nina,maria. due dates set.
sanjay: let's do a 15m async check-in next Friday to confirm rollouts and any blockers.
maria: works. I'll post any blockers in the ticket.
kevin: ping me 10m before. I'll have draft ready. :thumbsup:
sanjay: thanks all — adding these to the postmortem follow-ups board. if anyone wants to split an item, call it out here. :eyes:
